insights.formula: (Other operating income + provision reversals) ÷ EBITDA; operating cash proxy ÷ EBITDA; capitalised own work

measures.label: Other operating income and provision reversals
Non-trading income as a share of ebitda

narrative.explanation: RON 40,000.00 of operating income is other operating income and provision reversals rather than trading margin — 13.8% of RON 290,000.00; the operating cash proxy is RON 260,000.00 against an EBITDA of RON 290,000.00, a conversion of 89.7%. Graded medium: the amount at stake is 13.8% of ebitda, against the ladder printed beside this finding. Non-trading income is graded against the EBITDA it is inside, so the severity answers "how much of this margin is not trading" rather than "is this a big number".
narrative.reason: the advisory lane was not invoked for this build
narrative.so_what: Strip the non-trading income out before applying any multiple. Provision reversals and other operating income do not recur, and an EBITDA that leans on them overstates the run rate.

insights.claim_template: Rebuilding the P&L from the accounts reaches {money:reconstructed}; statutory profit in account 121 is {money:statutory}. The unexplained step of {money:step} is {measure:graded_share} of the {money:graded_base} it is bridging.

facts.label: Step to account 121 no line explains
facts.name: assembled_pl.net_income_unexplained_vs_121

insights.formula: |step to account 121 no line explains| ÷ |net income the lines reach| (the named lines — own work capitalised and, since 2026-09-26, the stock variation 711 — are not part of the step)

measures.label: Step to account 121 no line explains
Net income rebuilt from the accounts
Step as a share of reconstructed net income

narrative.explanation: Rebuilding the P&L from the accounts reaches RON 120,000.00; statutory profit in account 121 is RON 122,000.00. The unexplained step of RON 2,000.00 is 1.7% of the RON 120,000.00 it is bridging. Graded low: the amount at stake is 1.7% of reconstructed net income, against the ladder printed beside this finding. The step is graded against the profit it is correcting. A bridge worth a tenth of the answer is a footnote; one worth half of it means the reconstruction is not the source of the printed profit.
narrative.reason: the advisory lane was not invoked for this build
narrative.so_what: Ask for the year-end journals behind the step to account 121 before relying on the reconstructed P&L for anything. A large bridge means the movement columns are not the source of the reported profit.

insights.rank_basis: Ranked by severity level, then by materiality descending; ties broken by detector id ascending. The top 5 carry into the executive summary.

severity.why: The step is graded against the profit it is correcting. A bridge worth a tenth of the answer is a footnote; one worth half of it means the reconstruction is not the source of the printed profit.

Net income rebuilt from the accounts
Step as a share of reconstructed net income

narrative.explanation: Rebuilding the P&L from the accounts reaches RON 120,000.00; statutory profit in account 121 is RON 250,000.00. The unexplained step of RON 130,000.00 is 108.3% of the RON 120,000.00 it is bridging. Graded critical: the amount at stake is 108.3% of reconstructed net income, against the ladder printed beside this finding. The step is graded against the profit it is correcting. A bridge worth a tenth of the answer is a footnote; one worth half of it means the reconstruction is not the source of the printed profit.
narrative.reason: the advisory lane was not invoked for this build
narrative.so_what: Ask for the year-end journals behind the step to account 121 before relying on the reconstructed P&L for anything. A large bridge means the movement columns are not the source of the reported profit.
